```{r seurat_standard}

library(Seurat)
library(Azimuth)
library(celldex)
library(glmGamPoi)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(future)
library(DoubletFinder)  
library(dplyr)          


# Set working directory 

work_dir <- "~/SynologyDrive/NeuroD_2024/"
setwd(work_dir)
plotdir <- file.path(work_dir, "plots")
dir.create(plotdir, showWarnings = FALSE)
cellranger_dir <- "/Volumes/centren/AG/AG-Newman/Newman/NeuroD scRNAseq/2024/A4794/"



# Load data
# Adjust each path to point to the folder containing "raw_feature_bc_matrix"
# This Data is from E17 cortex

NeuroD1KO <- Read10X(data.dir = file.path(cellranger_dir,
                                          "A4794_SP278_NeuroD1KO/outs",
                                          "filtered_feature_bc_matrix"))
NeuroD2_D6DKO <- Read10X(data.dir = file.path(cellranger_dir,
                                              "A4794_SP278_NeuroD2_D6DKO/outs",
                                              "filtered_feature_bc_matrix"))
NeuroDTKO <- Read10X(data.dir = file.path(cellranger_dir,
                                          "A4794_SP278_NeuroDTKO/outs",
                                          "filtered_feature_bc_matrix"))
WT <- Read10X(data.dir = file.path(cellranger_dir,
                                   "A4794_SP278_wt/outs",
                                   "filtered_feature_bc_matrix"))


# Prefix cell barcodes to make them unique
colnames(NeuroD1KO) <- paste0("NeuroD1KO_", colnames(NeuroD1KO))
colnames(NeuroD2_D6DKO) <- paste0("NeuroD2_D6DKO_", colnames(NeuroD2_D6DKO))
colnames(NeuroDTKO) <- paste0("NeuroDTKO_", colnames(NeuroDTKO))
colnames(WT) <- paste0("WT_", colnames(WT))

# Combine matrices (rows are genes, columns are cells)

combined_counts <- cbind(NeuroD1KO, NeuroD2_D6DKO, NeuroDTKO, WT)


# Add metadata
meta_data <- data.frame(
  Genotype = factor(
    c(rep("NeuroD1KO", ncol(NeuroD1KO)),
      rep("NeuroD2_D6DKO", ncol(NeuroD2_D6DKO)),
      rep("NeuroDTKO", ncol(NeuroDTKO)),
      rep("WT", ncol(WT))),
    levels = c("WT", "NeuroD1KO", "NeuroD2_D6DKO", "NeuroDTKO")  # Factor level order
  ),
  row.names = colnames(combined_counts)
)

# Create a Seurat object

options(Seurat.object.assay.calcn = TRUE)
sc_seurat <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts = combined_counts,
  min.cells = 3,
  min.features = 200,
  meta.data = meta_data
)

#Remove sparse matrices to save RAM
rm(NeuroD1KO, NeuroD2_D6DKO, NeuroDTKO, WT)

saveRDS(sc_seurat, file = file.path(work_dir, "seurat_pre_filter.rds"))
# Calculate QC metrics: percent of mitochondrial and ribosomal genes

sc_seurat[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(sc_seurat, pattern = "^mt-")
sc_seurat[["percent.rbp"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(sc_seurat, pattern = "^Rp[sl]")

# Pre-filter QC plots

VlnPlot(sc_seurat, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt", "percent.rbp"), ncol = 4)
ggsave(filename = file.path(plotdir, "QC_combined_pre-filter.pdf"), width = 20, height = 18, units = "cm")

# Filter cells
# Adjust thresholds as appropriate 
sc_seurat <- subset(sc_seurat, subset = nFeature_RNA > 400 & percent.mt < 5)

# Post-filter QC plots
VlnPlot(sc_seurat, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt", "percent.rbp"), ncol = 4)
ggsave(filename = file.path(plotdir, "QC_combined_post-filter.pdf"), width = 20, height = 18, units = "cm")

# allow up to 40 GB
options(future.globals.maxSize = 40 * 1024^3)
plan("multicore")

# Standard workflow: normalization, feature selection, scaling, PCA, UMAP
sc_seurat <- sc_seurat %>%
  NormalizeData() %>%
  FindVariableFeatures(selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000) %>%
  ScaleData() %>%
  RunPCA() %>%
  RunUMAP(dims = 1:30)

DimPlot(sc_seurat, split.by = "Genotype")
ggsave(filename = file.path(plotdir, "UMAP_post-filter_pre_doublet_removal.pdf"), width = 30, height = 15, units = "cm")

# Doublet detection with DoubletFinder
# Split by genotype, run DoubletFinder on each subset, then merge back

seurat_list <- SplitObject(sc_seurat, split.by = "Genotype")

doublet_dir <- file.path(plotdir, "DoubletFinder")
dir.create(doublet_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

doublet_metrics <- list()

for (i in seq_along(seurat_list)) {
  sample_name <- names(seurat_list)[i]
  message("Processing sample: ", sample_name)
  
  DefaultAssay(seurat_list[[i]]) <- "RNA"
  
  # Find neighbors/clusters
  seurat_list[[i]] <- FindNeighbors(seurat_list[[i]], dims = 1:30)
  seurat_list[[i]] <- FindClusters(seurat_list[[i]], resolution = 0.4)
  
  # Parameter sweep
  sweep.res <- paramSweep(seurat_list[[i]], PCs = 1:30, sct = FALSE)
  sweep.stats <- summarizeSweep(sweep.res, GT = FALSE)
  bcmvn <- find.pK(sweep.stats)
  
  # Optimal pK
  optimal.pK <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric), "pK"]))
  
  # Homotypic doublet proportion
  annotations <- seurat_list[[i]]@meta.data$seurat_clusters
  homotypic.prop <- modelHomotypic(annotations)
  
  # Number of expected doublets (default 5%; adjust as needed)
  nExp_poi <- round(ncol(seurat_list[[i]]) * 0.05)
  nExp_poi.adj <- round(nExp_poi * (1 - homotypic.prop))
  
  # Run DoubletFinder
  seurat_list[[i]] <- doubletFinder(
    seurat_list[[i]],
    PCs = 1:30,
    pN = 0.25,
    pK = optimal.pK,
    nExp = nExp_poi.adj,
    reuse.pANN = FALSE,
    sct = FALSE
  )
  
  # Identify the classification column from DoubletFinder
  classification_col <- grep("^DF.classifications_", 
                             colnames(seurat_list[[i]]@meta.data), 
                             value = TRUE)
  
  # Visualize doublets vs. singlets
  DimPlot(seurat_list[[i]], reduction = "umap", group.by = classification_col) +
    ggtitle(paste0("DoubletFinder Results: ", sample_name)) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
  ggsave(filename = file.path(doublet_dir, paste0(sample_name, "_DoubletFinder_UMAP.pdf")),
         width = 10, height = 8)
  
  # Collect metrics
  total_cells <- ncol(seurat_list[[i]])
  doublet_count <- sum(seurat_list[[i]]@meta.data[[classification_col]] == "Doublet")
  singlet_count <- sum(seurat_list[[i]]@meta.data[[classification_col]] == "Singlet")
  
  doublet_metrics[[sample_name]] <- data.frame(
    Sample = sample_name,
    Total_Cells = total_cells,
    Expected_Doublets = nExp_poi,
    Adjusted_Expected_Doublets = nExp_poi.adj,
    Doublet_Count = doublet_count,
    Singlet_Count = singlet_count
  )
  
  # Keep only singlets
  singlet_cells <- rownames(
    seurat_list[[i]]@meta.data[
      seurat_list[[i]]@meta.data[[classification_col]] == "Singlet", ]
  )
  seurat_list[[i]] <- subset(seurat_list[[i]], cells = singlet_cells)
  
  # Optionally remove other assays to reduce object size
  seurat_list[[i]] <- DietSeurat(seurat_list[[i]], assays = "RNA")
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Merge cleaned samples back together
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
sc_seurat <- merge(seurat_list[[1]], y = seurat_list[-1])
sc_seurat <- JoinLayers(sc_seurat)  # if needed for Seurat layering

# Combine doublet metrics into a single data frame
metrics_df <- do.call(rbind, doublet_metrics)

# Save metrics to CSV
write.csv(metrics_df,
          file = file.path(doublet_dir, "DoubletFinder_Metrics_All_Samples.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

# Re-run standard workflow after doublet removal

sc_seurat <- sc_seurat %>%
  NormalizeData() %>%
  FindVariableFeatures(selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000) %>%
  ScaleData() %>%
  RunPCA() %>%
  RunUMAP(dims = 1:30) %>%
  FindNeighbors(dims = 1:30) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.5)

DimPlot(sc_seurat, split.by = "Genotype")
ggsave(filename = file.path(plotdir, "UMAP_post-filter_post_doublet_removal.pdf"), width = 30, height = 15, units = "cm")

# Run Azimuth
DefaultAssay(sc_seurat) <- "RNA"
sc_seurat <- NormalizeData(sc_seurat) 
sc_seurat <- Azimuth::RunAzimuth(sc_seurat, reference = "mousecortexref")

saveRDS(sc_seurat, file = file.path(work_dir,"scNeuroD_2025_doublet_Removed_azimuth.rds"))

```

```{r plot_functions}

# Function to generate FeaturePlots for a list of genes and save each plot
save_feature_plots <- function(seurat_obj, genes, plotdir, reduction = "ref.umap", assay = "RNA") {
  # Ensure the directory exists
  if (!dir.exists(plotdir)) dir.create(plotdir, recursive = TRUE)
  
  # Set default assay
  DefaultAssay(seurat_obj) <- assay
  
  # Loop through each gene and generate FeaturePlot
  for (gene in genes) {
    # Generate the plot
    plot <- FeaturePlot(seurat_obj, 
                        reduction = reduction, 
                        order = TRUE, 
                        features = gene, 
                        coord.fixed = TRUE,
                        pt.size = 0.1
                        ) +
    scale_color_gradient(low = "lightblue", high = "darkblue") +
    xlab("UMAP 1")+
    ylab("UMAP 2")
    # Save the plot to a PDF file
    file_name <- paste0(plotdir, "/", gene, "_expression_all_", reduction, ".pdf")
    ggsave(file_name, plot = plot, width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300)
    
    # Print a message for progress tracking
    message("Saved FeaturePlot for gene: ", gene)
  }
}

save_feature_plots_split <- function(seurat_obj, genes, plotdir, reduction = "ref.umap", assay = "RNA") {
  # Ensure the directory exists
  if (!dir.exists(plotdir)) dir.create(plotdir, recursive = TRUE)
  
  # Set default assay
  DefaultAssay(seurat_obj) <- assay
  
  # Loop through each gene and generate FeaturePlot
  for (gene in genes) {
    # Generate the plot
    plot <- FeaturePlot(seurat_obj, 
                        reduction = reduction, 
                        split.by = "Genotype",
                        order = TRUE, 
                        features = gene,
                        pt.size = 0.1,
                        cols = c("lightblue","darkblue"),
                        coord.fixed = TRUE
                        ) +
    theme(
        legend.position = "right",  # Ensure the legend is shown
        legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 8)
    )+
    xlab("UMAP 1")+
    ylab("UMAP 2")
    # Save the plot to a PDF file
    file_name <- paste0(plotdir, "/", gene,  "_expression_all_split_by_genotype_", reduction, ".pdf")
    ggsave(file_name, plot = plot, width = 12, height = 5, dpi = 300)
    
    # Print a message for progress tracking
    message("Saved FeaturePlot Split for gene: ", gene)
  }
}
```

```{r subset}
# Set default assay to RNA for Azimuth
DefaultAssay(sc_seurat) <- "RNA"

# subset to just WT and NeuroD2 NeuroD6 DKO
NdDKO <- subset(sc_seurat, Genotype %in% c("WT","NeuroD2_D6DKO"))

# Subset to Tbr2 positive fraction
Tbr2.pos <- subset(NdDKO, Eomes > 0) %>%
  DietSeurat(assays = "RNA", dimreducs = NULL)

# Set default assay to RNA for Azimuth
DefaultAssay(Tbr2.pos) <- "RNA"

# Normalize the data for Azimuth
Tbr2.pos <- NormalizeData(Tbr2.pos)

# Run Azimuth
# not run, this is for adult cortex and cannot annotate embyronic
#Tbr2.pos <- Azimuth::RunAzimuth(Tbr2.pos, reference = "mousecortexref")

# Standard seurat workflow
Tbr2.pos <- Tbr2.pos %>%
  FindVariableFeatures(selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000) %>%
  ScaleData() %>%
  RunPCA(npcs = 30, verbose = FALSE) %>%
  RunUMAP(reduction = "pca", 
          dims = 1:30,
          n.neighbors = 20,  # Smaller neighborhood for tighter clusters
          min.dist = 0.2,    # Smaller minimum distance for closer points
          verbose = FALSE) %>%
  FindNeighbors(dims = 1:30, k.param = 10, verbose = FALSE) %>%
  FindClusters(algorithm = 1, resolution = 0.2, verbose = FALSE)
```

```{r DEresults}

Tbr2.pos <- sc_seurat

Idents(Tbr2.pos) <- "seurat_clusters"
Tbr2DEclust <- FindAllMarkers(Tbr2.pos)

Tbr2DEclust <- subset(Tbr2DEclust, p_val_adj < 0.0001  )



Idents(Tbr2.pos) <- "Genotype"
Tbr2DE <- FindMarkers(Tbr2.pos, 
                       ident.1 = "NeuroD2_D6DKO",
                       ident.2 = "WT", 
                       min.pct = 0.1, 
                       logfc.threshold = 1
                       )

Tbr2DE.top <- subset(Tbr2DE, abs(avg_log2FC) > 1 & p_val_adj < 0.01)

write.table(Tbr2DE.top, file = "Tbr2_positive_cells_DKO_vs_WT_log2FC_1_padj_0.01.csv", sep = ",")

DotPlot(sc_seurat, features = c("Eomes","Pax6","Satb2"))


DE_results <- list()
Idents(Tbr2.pos) <- "seurat_clusters"
# Loop through each subclass and calculate DE between Genotypes (WT vs. Nurr1KO)
for (subclass in unique(Tbr2.pos$seurat_clusters)) {
  subclass_cells <- subset(Tbr2.pos, idents = subclass)  # Subset cells for the subclass
  Idents(subclass_cells) <- "Genotype"  # Set identity to Genotype
  DE_results[[subclass]] <- FindMarkers(subclass_cells, ident.1 = "NeuroD2_D6DKO", ident.2 = "WT", min.pct = 0.1, logfc.threshold = 1)
}

# Extract top genes for each subclass
top_genes_by_cluster <- unique(unlist(lapply(DE_results, function(x) {
  # Filter DE results by p-value, log2FC, and percent expression thresholds
  x <- x[x$p_val_adj < 0.01 & 
           abs(x$avg_log2FC) > 1 &
            x$pct.1 > 0.1 &
            x$pct.2 > 0.1
         , ]
  # Select the top 200 genes based on log2 fold change
  rownames(head(x[order(-abs(x$avg_log2FC)), ], 200))  
})))

# Create a combined grouping column
Tbr2.pos$cluster_genotype <- paste(Tbr2.pos$seurat_clusters, Tbr2.pos$Genotype, sep = "_")

# Generate the heatmap grouped by the combined field
DoHeatmap(
  object = Tbr2.pos,
  features = top_genes_by_cluster,  # Top DE genes
  group.by = "seurat_clusters",  # Group cells by subclass and genotype
  cells = colnames(Tbr2.pos),  # Use all cells
  group.bar = TRUE,  # Add a group bar
  label = TRUE  # Label clusters or groups
) + ggtitle("Heatmap of Top DE Genes by Subclass and Genotype")

top_genes <- unique(top_genes_by_cluster, rownames(Tbr2DE.top))


Idents(Tbr2.pos) <- "seurat_clusters"
DotPlot(Tbr2.pos, assay = "RNA",
        features = top_genes, group.by = "seurat_clusters", split.by = "Genotype") + coord_flip() +RotatedAxis()
```

```{r heatmap}
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)

# Set the Default Assay to RNA
DefaultAssay(Tbr2.pos) <- "RNA"

# Ensure data is scaled
Tbr2.pos <- ScaleData(Tbr2.pos, features = rownames(Tbr2.pos))

# Extract scaled expression data
expression_matrix <- GetAssayData(Tbr2.pos, layer = "scale.data")

# Subset the matrix for top genes
expression_matrix <- expression_matrix[intersect(rownames(expression_matrix), top_genes), ]

# Match cell metadata for column annotations
annotation_data <- Tbr2.pos@meta.data[colnames(expression_matrix), c("seurat_clusters", "Genotype")]

annotation_data$Genotype <- factor(annotation_data$Genotype, levels = c("WT","NeuroD2_D6DKO"))

# Create a custom column ordering: sort by subclass, then genotype
column_order <- order(annotation_data$Genotype, annotation_data$predicted.subclass )

# Reorder the expression matrix and annotations
expression_matrix <- expression_matrix[, column_order]
annotation_data <- annotation_data[column_order, ]

# Create named color vectors for annotations
subclass_colors <- setNames(rainbow(length(unique(annotation_data$predicted.subclass))),
                            unique(annotation_data$predicted.subclass))
genotype_colors <- c("WT" = "grey80", "NeuroD2_D6DKO" = "maroon")

# Create column annotation for subclasses and genotypes
col_annotation <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Genotype = annotation_data$Genotype,
  Subclass = annotation_data$predicted.subclass,
  col = list(
    Genotype = genotype_colors,
    Subclass = subclass_colors
  )
)

always_label_genes <- gene_list

# Indices of genes to always label
always_label_indices <- which(rownames(expression_matrix) %in% always_label_genes)

# Step through and label every 4th gene
step_indices <- seq(1, nrow(expression_matrix), by = 5)  # Use nrow to reference row indices

# Combine the indices and ensure uniqueness and sorting
combined_indices <- unique(sort(c(step_indices, always_label_indices)))

# Extract the gene names for the combined indices
combined_labels <- rownames(expression_matrix)[combined_indices]


# Create the row annotations
genelabels <- rowAnnotation(
  Genes = anno_mark(
    at = combined_indices,
    labels = combined_labels,
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11, fontface = 'italic'),
    padding = 0.5),
  width = unit(2.0, 'cm') +
    max_text_width(
      combined_labels,
      gp = gpar(fontsize = 11, fontface = 'italic'))
)

# Generate the heatmap with custom column ordering
heat<-Heatmap(expression_matrix,
        name = "Scaled Expression",  # Legend title
        top_annotation = col_annotation,  # Column annotations
        show_row_names = TRUE,  # Show gene names
        show_column_names = FALSE,  # Hide cell names
        cluster_rows = TRUE, 
        column_split = annotation_data$Genotype,# Cluster genes
        cluster_columns = FALSE,  # Do not cluster columns; use custom order
        column_title = "Genotype and Predicted Subclass",
        row_title = "Top Genes",
        row_km = 2,
        row_gap = unit(0.5, "mm"),
        column_gap = unit(0.5, "mm"),
        clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2", 
        #clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
        use_raster = TRUE,
        raster_by_magick = TRUE,
        col = colorRamp2(c(-3, 0, 3), hcl_palette = "Spectral"),
        heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "Scaled Expression"))
pdf("___heatmap_sort_geno_no_column_cluster.pdf", width=8,height = 8)
heat+genelabels
dev.off()
```
